entities.summary: Perm National Research Polytechnic University is a multidisciplinary higher educational institution that provides training for scientific, technical, technological, economic, managerial, social and humanitarian areas and specialties for enterprises and organizations of the Western Ural and Russia. The university is located in the city of Perm, Perm Krai, Russia. Its rector is Anatoly Таshkinov.
